title: Quantum Innovations Policy Update
content: Discussed potential changes to the work-life balance policy. The aim is to allow more flexible working hours and the possibility of a four-day workweek. Details are still being finalized, and employees will be surveyed for their input before any decisions are made.

title: Quantum Cohesion Day Planning
content: Finalized the agenda for Quantum Cohesion Day on March 10th. Activities include team-building exercises, a motivational speaker, and a catered lunch. Employees are encouraged to participate and provide suggestions for activities.
